principles: Question presentation is driven by question type, not by page position.
Images reinforce the subject of a question or section; they are not required for every question.
Question wording, supporting text, image references and translations remain data-driven.
The UI never communicates a medical diagnosis, health score or disease risk.
The underlying numeric stored value is invisible to the user.
Signal strength belongs to the report layer, not the questionnaire answer control.
Conditional follow-ups appear inside the same interaction context as the parent question.
Accessibility must not depend on colour, imagery or iconography.

journey.label: About you
journey.purpose: Basic details, profile context and goals.

journey.label: Your lifestyle
journey.purpose: Food, activity, sleep and exposure context.

journey.label: Your body
journey.purpose: Body-system and life-stage context where relevant.

single_select.desktop: Horizontal choices when 2-5 options fit comfortably; otherwise stacked choice cards.
single_select.selection: Single selected state with clear border/fill change.

frequency_4.mobile: Two-column grid or vertical stack depending on label length.
frequency_4.helper: Optional short recall-period line below question.

frequency_5.mobile: Scrollable horizontal row only if necessary; prefer stacked/2-column cards for long labels.
frequency_5.helper: Use only when the five labels are semantically ordered.

quality_5.desktop: Five equal-width cards with the semantic endpoints visually clear.
quality_5.helper: Do not use colour alone to imply good/bad health.

multi_select.desktop: 2-column cards for 4+ options; compact list for 2-3.
multi_select.logic: Mutual-exclusion rules must be encoded in question logic, not assumed by UI.

question_card.desktop: Prefer one or two cards per row depending on question type; never force five-option scales into four-column cards.
question_card.navigation: Back and Next fixed at the bottom of the question area; do not advance until required response is valid.

evidence_panel.content: Plain-English reason for inclusion, followed by optional evidence/source disclosure.
evidence_panel.boundary: Must explain the question without implying diagnosis, causation or treatment.

image_system.section_images: Large, calm hero illustrations for section introductions.
image_system.question_images: Optional small subject illustration or icon. Use only when it improves comprehension.
image_system.profile_variants: Use gender/profile-specific imagery only when genuinely relevant. Prefer subject-based imagery.
image_system.accessibility: Decorative images receive empty alt text; informative images receive meaningful alt text.

response_rules.yes_no: Use large choice cards, not tiny radio buttons.
response_rules.frequency: Use ordered response cards with consistent left-to-right semantics on desktop.
response_rules.quality: Use semantic labels, not green-to-red health grading.
response_rules.multi_select: Use checkboxes and explicit mutual-exclusion logic.
response_rules.single_select: Use radio semantics and full-card click target.
response_rules.free_text: Use contextual follow-up inside the parent card.

report_boundary: The questionnaire collects self-reported wellness information. It does not diagnose conditions, establish disease risk, or recommend treatment.
